note: The board draws scrychat v2 as the issues propose it, not as it is today - today scrychat has no three-column UI at all. The target is farseek's layout, rebuilt from measured tokens and geometry; no markup or CSS was copied. Each pin marks the region that has to exist for its issue to be done. A pin whose anchor is not in mockup.html fails the build, so target and tracker cannot drift apart silently.

issues.title: Oracle: collection/printing analysis and originality scoring
issues.pin: Moved here from farseek-teardown gitea #3, where it did not belong - it is a scrychat feature request, not a teardown finding. Originality scoring is the natural extension of our 'no popularity prior' stance. Their ranking formula is server-side and uncopyable; only the idea transfers, implemented with our published formula. Output shape is STATED, not MEASURED - a real-deck Oracle reading was gated on account age and never ran.
